headlines.title: 구윤철 “ 나프타, 의료·생필품에 최우선 공급 ”
headlines.summary: 석유화학 7개 유분 위기품목 지정 공공계약 ‘90일 룰’ 완화 등 추진 구윤철 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관이 10일 정부서울청사에서 열린 ‘비상경제본부회의 겸 경제관계장관회의’를 주재, 모두발언을 하고 있다. 사진 제공=재정경제부 정부가 품귀 현상을 빚고 있는 나프타 등 핵심 원료를 보건의료·생활필수품에 최우선 공급하기로 했다.

headlines.title: “더는 유출 그만!”… 정부, 780억 가상자산 관리 강화
headlines.summary: 가상자산 징수액 3년 새 100배...공공기관 유출 사고 반복 압류 즉시 ‘콜드월렛’ 기관지갑 보관 규정 위반시 고발 및 징계까지 가상자산. (사진=연합뉴스) 정부가 최근 반복되고 있는 공공분야 가상자산 유출 사고에 대응하기 위해 가상자산 보유·관리 전 단계에 걸친 관리 시스템을 마련한다.

headlines.title: 정부 '압수 코인' 이중 보안망 짠다

headlines.title: '국채 발행 없이' 26 조 전쟁 추경 …국민 70%에 지원금

key_headlines.title: Government Prioritizes NAFTA Supply to Healthcare and Essential Goods
key_headlines.summary: Deputy Prime Minister Koo Yun-chul announced that the government will prioritize supply of critical raw materials like NAFTA to healthcare and essential consumer goods sectors, while designating seven petrochemical byproducts as crisis items and relaxing the 90-day public contract rule.

key_headlines.title: Government Strengthens Cryptocurrency Asset Management System to Prevent Public Sector Losses
key_headlines.summary: The government has established a comprehensive management system for cryptocurrency assets held by public agencies, with 78 billion won in seized assets to be immediately stored in institutional cold wallets, and officials facing prosecution and disciplinary action for violations.

key_headlines.title: 26 Trillion Won Emergency Budget Compiled Without Bond Issuance, Targeting Bottom 70% Income Earners
key_headlines.summary: The government approved a 26.2 trillion won emergency supplementary budget using surplus tax revenue to provide high oil price damage support payments to the bottom 70% of income earners and stimulate consumer spending amid economic downturn.

key_headlines.title: Bank of Korea Maintains Base Rate at 2.50% for Seventh Consecutive Meeting
key_headlines.summary: The Monetary Policy Committee unanimously decided to hold the base rate at 2.50% as international oil prices and won-dollar exchange rates remain elevated due to Middle East conflict, with May economic forecast signaling significant upward revision of inflation expectations.

key_headlines.title: KOSPI Closes 1.40% Higher on Easing Middle East Tensions
key_headlines.summary: The KOSPI index rose to 5,858.87 points with foreign investors net buying 1.01 trillion won as concerns about Middle East conflict eased, while semiconductor stocks reached historic highs with the semiconductor index climbing 2.31%.

sections.Hot Economy News: The South Korean government is implementing comprehensive measures to address immediate economic challenges following Middle East conflict escalation. A 26.2 trillion won emergency budget has been compiled without issuing government bonds, utilizing surplus tax revenue to provide relief payments to the bottom 70% of income earners and stimulate domestic consumption. Critically, the government has prioritized supply of NAFTA and other essential raw materials to healthcare and consumer goods sectors facing shortages. Additionally, public sector cryptocurrency asset management has been strengthened significantly, with 78 billion won in seized assets now subject to enhanced security protocols and institutional oversight to prevent recurring loss incidents.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Bank of Korea maintained its base rate at 2.50% for the seventh consecutive meeting with unanimous committee approval, citing persistent external uncertainties from Middle East tensions and elevated international oil prices. Economic growth projections have been revised downward, with the central bank now expecting 2026 growth to fall below the 2% previous estimate due to prolonged Middle East conflict impacts. Inflation expectations have been substantially revised upward from the previous 2.2% forecast, reflecting elevated oil prices and won-dollar exchange rate pressures. The government's supplementary budget using surplus revenues is viewed positively for supporting aggregate demand, though uncertainties surrounding oil supply normalization remain a key variable in monetary policy decisions.
sections.Financial Markets: Stock markets responded positively to easing Middle East tensions, with the KOSPI closing 1.40% higher at 5,858.87 points on April 10. Foreign investors led the gains with net purchases of 1.01 trillion won, while individuals and institutions posted net selling positions. The semiconductor sector recorded historic highs with the semiconductor index rising 2.31%, driven by strong NVIDIA performance (+2.55%) and sustained AI chip demand. ETF net assets are approaching the 400 trillion won threshold as market sentiment improves. The won-dollar exchange rate remained stable at 1,482.5, reflecting balanced foreign exchange market conditions amid ongoing geopolitical uncertainties.
sections.Industry & Technology: The semiconductor sector demonstrated exceptional strength with the semiconductor index reaching historic highs and individual chipmakers like NVIDIA surging 2.55%. However, individual retail investors have engaged in substantial net selling of major semiconductor stocks including Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix totaling approximately 9 trillion won, suggesting skepticism about the semiconductor super-cycle narrative. Hyundai Motor and Tesla are intensifying electric vehicle competition in the Chinese market with new product launches targeting the world's largest automotive consumer base. Semiconductor equipment manufacturers and specialized component suppliers, including companies like Daehan Optical Communication and Samsung Electro-Mechanics, are attracting investor attention with new record price achievements in defense and power equipment sectors.
sections.Real Estate: Real estate policy debates have intensified with political figures advocating for accelerated reconstruction and redevelopment projects in Seoul, particularly Gangnam areas. Current discussions focus on eliminating government lending restrictions on real estate as a prerequisite for project acceleration, with officials arguing that indiscriminate credit constraints hinder legitimate property development. School-zone apartments targeting families with children in the 30-40 age demographic are entering the market in earnest, reflecting demographic shifts in primary real estate demand. Reconstruction and redevelopment project management governance issues remain prominent, with attention to legitimate procedures for dismissing cooperative leadership and ensuring transparent project operations.
sections.International Economy: The U.S. economy showed slower-than-expected quarterly growth with Q4 2025 GDP growth at only 0.5%, while the Federal Reserve indicated uncertainty regarding interest rate direction for upcoming policy decisions. Twenty-four U.S. states have challenged President Trump's 10% tariff order in international trade courts, contesting its legal basis under 1974 trade law provisions. The Middle East conflict has elevated energy price uncertainty, preventing the Fed from committing to specific rate directions, with both hikes and cuts remaining under consideration. The U.S.-China semiconductor regulatory competition is expected to create supply chain disruptions globally, as both nations strengthen controls over semiconductor technology and advanced chip manufacturing capabilities.
sections.AI & Economy: The government is advancing AI agent adoption in public administration through various initiatives including the Science and Technology Ministry's administrative automation experiments and the Ministry of Strategy and Finance's 'AI-ONE Platform' project for integrated document management systems. Anthropic is reportedly considering development of proprietary AI chips to reduce dependency on NVIDIA and Google solutions, signaling increasing competition in AI infrastructure. Meta has shifted AI strategy toward closed-source model development with its new 'Muse Spark' AI model, prioritizing revenue monetization over open-source ecosystem expansion. TSMC's earnings surprise reflects sustained AI semiconductor demand from NVIDIA's B200/B300 accelerators and Apple's advanced chip production, indicating no reduction in AI-driven semiconductor demand despite market sentiment fluctuations.
sections.Others: The Ministry of Labor confirmed a 416.5 billion won supplementary budget allocation focused on mitigating employment shocks from Middle East conflict impacts through job creation and worker support programs. Cryptocurrency markets showed bitcoin stabilizing around 66,000 dollars as a key technical support level, with the asset recovering from initial conflict-driven gains as extended conflict duration created downward pressure. Transformer and power equipment manufacturers are positioned for significant revenue growth opportunities driven by global power grid modernization requirements and AI data center expansion, with industry projections suggesting substantial salary increases for skilled workforce. Various regulatory and enforcement actions continue addressing illicit activities including drug smuggling operations exploiting international supply chains.
